name: nordata.io
description: nordata.io has indexed all companies and voluntary organizations from the Brønnøysund Register Centre. This includes historical data and financial figures from 2024 and 2025. We have also added map data. You can now query for carpenters within 1km of your current location with more than 10 employees. For example...

_published_faq.name: How do I add nordata.io to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add nordata.io to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://nordata.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the nordata.io MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: nordata.io provides these MCP tools: search_companies, search_addresses, search_voluntary_organizations, list_available_apis, get_search_syntax_guide, get_norwegian_industry_codes, get_norwegian_municipalities, and get_current_month_usage.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to nordata.io?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to nordata.io in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
nordata.io requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
nordata.io is developed by DisruptingIT AS. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
